Body.Content:
Issues have been fixed in the latest versions of these Azure Site Recovery components:

  • Site Recovery unified setup and Site Recovery mobility agent for Windows/CentOS/Ubuntu machines (9.29.5367.1) for replication of VMware virtual machines and physical servers to Azure.
  • Site Recovery configuration server (5.1.5000.0) for replication of VMware virtual machines and physical servers to Azure.
  • Azure Recovery Services agent (2.0.9165.0) for replication of Hyper-V virtual machines to Azure.

For more information about the issues that were fixed and prerequisites for installing the update, and to get download links, read more about the update.
